body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
html.dark .breadcrumb a, html.dark .next-solutions a { color: rgb(143, 211, 255); border-color: rgb(143, 211, 255); }
.breadcrumb ol { list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; }

nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-sub nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-home nav.breadcrumb, nav.jump-nav, body.toc-sub nav.jump-nav { position: static; background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; border: 0px; backdrop-filter: none; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .impact-box { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark footer, html.dark .impact, html.dark .impact-bar, html.dark #actions { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.myths, .mission-log { max-width: 60rem; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 1.25rem 1rem; display: grid; gap: 1.2rem; }
.myth-card, .log-entry { background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; }
.myth-card h2, .log-entry h2 { margin: 0.2rem 0px 0.8rem; font-size: 1.3rem; text-align: left; }

.new-callout a { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem 0.9rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 2px solid var(--brand-blue); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 8px 22px; }

.new-badge { background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(15, 27, 38); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.92) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background: var(--lg-solid,#1d3f73) !important; }}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav, body.toc-home nav.scrolled, body.toc-sub nav.scrolled, .nav-sub, .dropdown-menu, body.toc-home .nav-links, body.toc-sub .nav-links, .hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .glass, #actions .mission-block { backdrop-filter: none !important; }body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgb(0, 20, 40) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; background-image: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; }}

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

@media (forced-colors: active){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { forced-color-adjust: auto; border: 1px solid buttontext !important; }}

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

#q { width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; font-size: 1.1rem; border: 2px solid rgb(0, 156, 222); border-radius: 8px; color: rgb(0, 55, 85); }
html.dark #q { background: rgb(21, 32, 51); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); border-color: rgb(77, 163, 255); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }

.sp-search-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; font-weight: 700; padding: 0px 1.4rem; border: 0px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(0, 156, 222); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); cursor: pointer; }
html.dark .sp-search-form #q { background: rgb(21, 32, 51); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); border: 2px solid rgb(77, 163, 255); }

.sp-q { flex: 0 0 auto; max-width: 17rem; white-space: normal; text-align: start; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(232, 244, 255); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(8, 20, 45, 0.62); border: 1px solid rgba(120, 190, 255, 0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 4px 16px; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; }
.sp-q:hover, .sp-q:focus-visible { background: rgba(0, 120, 200, 0.75); border-color: rgb(159, 212, 255); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }

@media (min-width: 1200px){.sp-q { position: absolute; width: 15.5rem; max-width: none; pointer-events: auto; animation: sp-bob calc(9s + var(--i) * 0.7s) ease-in-out calc(var(--i) * -1.3s) infinite alternate; }.sp-float:hover .sp-q, .sp-q:focus-visible { animation-play-state: paused; }}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.sp-q { animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none !important; }}
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

.sticky-help { position: fixed; inset-inline-end: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1100; background: rgb(46, 158, 79); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 6px 18px; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.92) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background: var(--lg-solid,#1d3f73) !important; }}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav, body.toc-home nav.scrolled, body.toc-sub nav.scrolled, .nav-sub, .dropdown-menu, body.toc-home .nav-links, body.toc-sub .nav-links, .hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .glass, #actions .mission-block { backdrop-filter: none !important; }body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgb(0, 20, 40) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; background-image: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; }}

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

@media (forced-colors: active){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { forced-color-adjust: auto; border: 1px solid buttontext !important; }}
html body .lw nav:not(#topnav) { background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; backdrop-filter: none; height: auto; position: static !important; }

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid, html body nav#topnav.spn-open { background: rgba(7, 16, 24, 0.96) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 6px 24px !important; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid::before, html body nav#topnav.spn-open::before { opacity: 0; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }
#topnav .spn-brand { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; }

@media (min-width: 1140px){#topnav .spn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 0px 1rem; }#topnav .spn-panel { display: contents; }#topnav .spn-brand { grid-area: 1 / 1; min-height: 32px; }#topnav .spn-util { grid-area: 1 / 2; justify-self: end; }#topnav .spn-main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; justify-self: end; }}
#topnav .spn-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
#topnav .spn-util { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0px 1.1rem; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
#topnav .spn-util a { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 32px; white-space: nowrap; }

#topnav .spn-util a.spn-ls { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-width: 44px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 0.3rem; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; color: rgb(201, 212, 223); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; touch-action: pan-y; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

#topnav .spn-ls-t { --spn-x: 0px; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(91, 103, 116); box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; transition: background-color 0.2s; }

#topnav .spn-ls-k { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 3px; transform: translateX(var(--spn-x)); transition: transform 0.2s; }
html body #topnav a.spn-ls:focus-visible { outline-offset: 1px; outline: rgb(143, 211, 255) solid 3px !important; }

#topnav .spn-trig { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 0.6rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-chev { width: 0px; height: 0px; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-right: 4px solid transparent; border-top: 5px solid; transition: transform 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open > .spn-trig { background: rgb(143, 211, 255); color: rgb(7, 16, 24); box-shadow: none; }

#topnav .spn-sub { position: absolute; top: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0px; min-width: 240px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility linear 0.18s; z-index: 5; margin-top: 6px !important; padding: 4px 0px !important; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open .spn-sub { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility; }
#topnav .spn-sub a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 1rem; color: rgb(232, 238, 245); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

html body #topnav .spn-cta a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0px 1.1rem !important; font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif !important; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
footer { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); font-size: 0.85rem; }
footer a { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration: underline; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
body.toc-sub .btn { background: rgb(0, 156, 222); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 22px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
body.toc-sub footer { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); font-size: 0.85rem; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
html.dark .btn, html.dark .btn-nav, html.dark body.toc-sub .btn { background: rgb(0, 123, 184); }
html.dark .btn:hover, html.dark .btn-nav:hover, html.dark body.toc-sub .btn:hover { background: rgb(0, 156, 222); }
html.dark .hero-email a:hover, html.dark .join-lead a:hover, html.dark footer a:hover, html.dark body.toc-sub footer a:hover, html.dark #actions .join-lead a:hover { color: rgb(77, 163, 255); }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .btn { position: static; display: inline-block; margin-top: 1.1rem; }
body.toc-sub .btn, body.toc-home .btn { background: rgb(0, 156, 222); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 22px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
body.toc-sub footer, body.toc-home footer { background: var(--toc-navy); padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark footer, html.dark .impact, html.dark .impact-bar, html.dark #actions { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); }
.nf-wrap { max-width: 640px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 2rem 1.5rem 3rem; text-align: center; }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }

body.toc-sub .w-card { padding: 1.2rem; background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }

.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }

.sticky-help { position: fixed; inset-inline-end: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1100; background: rgb(46, 158, 79); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 6px 18px; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

.aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 0px 2px 6px !important; background-image: none !important; }

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

html body .lw nav:not(#topnav) { background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; backdrop-filter: none; height: auto; position: static !important; }

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid, html body nav#topnav.spn-open { background: rgba(7, 16, 24, 0.96) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 6px 24px !important; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid::before, html body nav#topnav.spn-open::before { opacity: 0; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }
#topnav .spn-brand { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; }

@media (min-width: 1140px){#topnav .spn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 0px 1rem; }#topnav .spn-panel { display: contents; }#topnav .spn-brand { grid-area: 1 / 1; min-height: 32px; }#topnav .spn-util { grid-area: 1 / 2; justify-self: end; }#topnav .spn-main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; justify-self: end; }}
#topnav .spn-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
#topnav .spn-util { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0px 1.1rem; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
#topnav .spn-util a { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 32px; white-space: nowrap; }

#topnav .spn-util a.spn-ls { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-width: 44px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 0.3rem; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; color: rgb(201, 212, 223); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; touch-action: pan-y; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

#topnav .spn-ls-t { --spn-x: 0px; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(91, 103, 116); box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; transition: background-color 0.2s; }

#topnav .spn-ls-k { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 3px; transform: translateX(var(--spn-x)); transition: transform 0.2s; }
html body #topnav a.spn-ls:focus-visible { outline-offset: 1px; outline: rgb(143, 211, 255) solid 3px !important; }

#topnav .spn-trig { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 0.6rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-chev { width: 0px; height: 0px; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-right: 4px solid transparent; border-top: 5px solid; transition: transform 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open > .spn-trig { background: rgb(143, 211, 255); color: rgb(7, 16, 24); box-shadow: none; }

#topnav .spn-sub { position: absolute; top: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0px; min-width: 240px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility linear 0.18s; z-index: 5; margin-top: 6px !important; padding: 4px 0px !important; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
.photo-credit { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0.4rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.7; text-align: right; }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

.sticky-help { position: fixed; inset-inline-end: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1100; background: rgb(46, 158, 79); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 6px 18px; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.92) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background: var(--lg-solid,#1d3f73) !important; }}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav, body.toc-home nav.scrolled, body.toc-sub nav.scrolled, .nav-sub, .dropdown-menu, body.toc-home .nav-links, body.toc-sub .nav-links, .hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .glass, #actions .mission-block { backdrop-filter: none !important; }body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgb(0, 20, 40) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; background-image: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; }}

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

@media (forced-colors: active){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { forced-color-adjust: auto; border: 1px solid buttontext !important; }}
html body .lw nav:not(#topnav) { background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; backdrop-filter: none; height: auto; position: static !important; }

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid, html body nav#topnav.spn-open { background: rgba(7, 16, 24, 0.96) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 6px 24px !important; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid::before, html body nav#topnav.spn-open::before { opacity: 0; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }
#topnav .spn-brand { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; }

@media (min-width: 1140px){#topnav .spn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 0px 1rem; }#topnav .spn-panel { display: contents; }#topnav .spn-brand { grid-area: 1 / 1; min-height: 32px; }#topnav .spn-util { grid-area: 1 / 2; justify-self: end; }#topnav .spn-main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; justify-self: end; }}
#topnav .spn-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
#topnav .spn-util { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0px 1.1rem; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
#topnav .spn-util a { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 32px; white-space: nowrap; }

#topnav .spn-util a.spn-ls { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-width: 44px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 0.3rem; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; color: rgb(201, 212, 223); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; touch-action: pan-y; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

#topnav .spn-ls-t { --spn-x: 0px; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(91, 103, 116); box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; transition: background-color 0.2s; }

#topnav .spn-ls-k { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 3px; transform: translateX(var(--spn-x)); transition: transform 0.2s; }
html body #topnav a.spn-ls:focus-visible { outline-offset: 1px; outline: rgb(143, 211, 255) solid 3px !important; }

#topnav .spn-trig { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 0.6rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-chev { width: 0px; height: 0px; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-right: 4px solid transparent; border-top: 5px solid; transition: transform 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open > .spn-trig { background: rgb(143, 211, 255); color: rgb(7, 16, 24); box-shadow: none; }

#topnav .spn-sub { position: absolute; top: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0px; min-width: 240px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility linear 0.18s; z-index: 5; margin-top: 6px !important; padding: 4px 0px !important; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
body.toc-sub .ws-grid, body.toc-sub .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .card-band .card, html.dark body.toc-sub .ps-card, html.dark body.toc-sub .w-card { background: rgb(15, 27, 38); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .w-card { padding: 1.2rem; background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
body.toc-sub .w-card p { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .w-card, html.dark .card, html.dark .dropdown-menu { background: rgb(21, 32, 51); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
body.toc-sub .w-card p.fact-source a, .impact-box p.fact-source a { color: rgb(143, 211, 255); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.visually-hidden { width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px); white-space: nowrap; border: 0px; position: absolute !important; }
.w-card .fact-img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 220px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; margin: 0.4rem 0px 0.3rem; }

.w-card .fact-credit, body.toc-sub .w-card p.fact-credit { font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 1.6vw, 0.62rem); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: 0.85; margin: 0px 0px 0.6rem; text-align: center; }
@media (max-width: 380px){.w-card .fact-credit, body.toc-sub .w-card p.fact-credit { white-space: normal; overflow: visible; }}

.af-motion-toggle { position: absolute; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0.75rem; z-index: 2; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.55); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.75; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

.sticky-help { position: fixed; inset-inline-end: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1100; background: rgb(46, 158, 79); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 6px 18px; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.92) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background: var(--lg-solid,#1d3f73) !important; }}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav, body.toc-home nav.scrolled, body.toc-sub nav.scrolled, .nav-sub, .dropdown-menu, body.toc-home .nav-links, body.toc-sub .nav-links, .hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .glass, #actions .mission-block { backdrop-filter: none !important; }body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgb(0, 20, 40) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; background-image: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; }}

@media (prefers-contrast: more){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { border: 2px solid rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }}

@media (forced-colors: active){.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn, .aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { forced-color-adjust: auto; border: 1px solid buttontext !important; }}
.cl-day h2 { font-size: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); padding-bottom: 0.3rem; }
html body .lw nav:not(#topnav) { background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; backdrop-filter: none; height: auto; position: static !important; }

html body nav#topnav { top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; position: fixed !important; height: auto !important; background: transparent !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0px !important; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s !important; }

html body nav#topnav::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px -28px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.72), rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35) 70%, rgba(0, 20, 40, 0)); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; z-index: -1; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid, html body nav#topnav.spn-open { background: rgba(7, 16, 24, 0.96) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 6px 24px !important; }
html body nav#topnav.spn-solid::before, html body nav#topnav.spn-open::before { opacity: 0; }

#topnav .spn { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 8px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 32px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: padding 0.3s; }
#topnav .spn-brand { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; }

@media (min-width: 1140px){#topnav .spn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 0px 1rem; }#topnav .spn-panel { display: contents; }#topnav .spn-brand { grid-area: 1 / 1; min-height: 32px; }#topnav .spn-util { grid-area: 1 / 2; justify-self: end; }#topnav .spn-main { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; justify-self: end; }}
#topnav .spn-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
#topnav .spn-util { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0px 1.1rem; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
#topnav .spn-util a { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 32px; white-space: nowrap; }

#topnav .spn-util a.spn-ls { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-width: 44px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0px 0.3rem; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; color: rgb(201, 212, 223); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; touch-action: pan-y; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

#topnav .spn-ls-t { --spn-x: 0px; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(91, 103, 116); box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; transition: background-color 0.2s; }

#topnav .spn-ls-k { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 3px; transform: translateX(var(--spn-x)); transition: transform 0.2s; }
html body #topnav a.spn-ls:focus-visible { outline-offset: 1px; outline: rgb(143, 211, 255) solid 3px !important; }

#topnav .spn-trig { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 0.6rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-chev { width: 0px; height: 0px; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-right: 4px solid transparent; border-top: 5px solid; transition: transform 0.2s; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open > .spn-trig { background: rgb(143, 211, 255); color: rgb(7, 16, 24); box-shadow: none; }

#topnav .spn-sub { position: absolute; top: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0px; min-width: 240px; background: rgb(15, 27, 38); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 14px 34px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility linear 0.18s; z-index: 5; margin-top: 6px !important; padding: 4px 0px !important; }
#topnav .spn-dd.is-open .spn-sub { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s, visibility; }
#topnav .spn-sub a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0px 1rem; color: rgb(232, 238, 245); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

html body #topnav .spn-cta a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0px 1.1rem !important; font: 700 15px / 1 Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif !important; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(0, 156, 222); margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: 1.25rem; }
body.toc-sub .ws-grid, body.toc-sub .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .card-band .card, html.dark body.toc-sub .ps-card, html.dark body.toc-sub .w-card { background: rgb(15, 27, 38); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .w-card { padding: 1.2rem; background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
body.toc-sub .w-card p { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; }
body.toc-sub .impact-box { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark .w-card, html.dark .card, html.dark .dropdown-menu { background: rgb(21, 32, 51); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark footer, html.dark .impact, html.dark .impact-bar, html.dark #actions { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); }
body.toc-sub .w-card p.fact-source a, .impact-box p.fact-source a { color: rgb(143, 211, 255); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

styles.css: @font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin-ext.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+100-2BA, U+2BD-2C5, U+2C7-2CC, U+2CE-2D7, U+2DD-2FF, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C4, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF; }

@font-face { font-family: Montserrat; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500 800; font-display: swap; src: url("assets/fonts/montserrat-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); unicode-range: U+0-FF, U+131, U+152-153, U+2BB-2BC, U+2C6, U+2DA, U+2DC, U+304, U+308, U+329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD; }
body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }

body { margin: 0px; font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
nav { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 1000; background: transparent; transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; }
body.toc-sub h2 { color: rgb(0, 55, 85); margin: 1.4rem 0px 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .card-band h2, html.dark .card-band h3, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3, html.dark .mission-block h2, html.dark .ps-card h3, html.dark .breadcrumb [aria-current] { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }

html.dark .stat-label, html.dark .stat-source, html.dark .ps-card small, html.dark .ps-note, html.dark .mw-date, html.dark .mw-note, html.dark .mw-status, html.dark .mw-count small { color: rgb(159, 179, 196); opacity: 1; }
html.dark .breadcrumb a, html.dark .next-solutions a { color: rgb(143, 211, 255); border-color: rgb(143, 211, 255); }
.breadcrumb ol { list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; }

nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-sub nav.breadcrumb, body.toc-home nav.breadcrumb, nav.jump-nav, body.toc-sub nav.jump-nav { position: static; background: none; box-shadow: none; z-index: auto; border: 0px; backdrop-filter: none; }
body.toc-home, body.toc-sub { font-family: Montserrat, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--toc-navy); }
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: 0px; background: var(--toc-navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; z-index: 2000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.35); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: none; z-index: 1000; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
body.toc-sub .impact-box { background: rgb(0, 55, 85); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem; box-shadow: rgba(0, 55, 85, 0.15) 0px 8px 22px; }
html.dark body.toc-home, html.dark body.toc-sub { background: rgb(11, 18, 32); color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark body.toc-home .mission-block h2, html.dark body.toc-home .card-band h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h2, html.dark body.toc-sub h3 { color: rgb(232, 238, 245); }
html.dark footer, html.dark .impact, html.dark .impact-bar, html.dark #actions { background: rgb(7, 16, 24); }
.photo-credit { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0.4rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.7; text-align: right; }
.mission-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(11, 37, 64); color: rgb(232, 243, 255); }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2, body.toc-sub .mission-widget h3 { color: rgb(232, 243, 255); margin: 0.9rem 0px 0.4rem; }
body.toc-sub .mission-widget h2 { margin: 0px 0px 0.4rem; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.mission-widget .mw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; }
.horizon-note { margin: 1rem 0px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid rgb(245, 185, 66); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.12); }

.horizon-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(245, 185, 66); color: rgb(29, 20, 0); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
[dir="rtl"] body { text-align: right; font-family: Montserrat, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; }
.sp-video { max-width: 960px; margin: 2.2rem auto 0px; padding: 0px 1.5rem; text-align: center; }
.sp-video video { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0, 0, 0); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 10px 28px; }
.nav-help a { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgb(46, 158, 79) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 0px !important; }

.sticky-help { position: fixed; inset-inline-end: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1100; background: rgb(46, 158, 79); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 6px 18px; text-decoration: none; }

.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help { backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%); text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 1px 2px; border-radius: 999px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.06)),var(--lg-tint) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0px 1px 0px inset, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px -1px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 6px 20px !important; }

.aud-icon, .eli10-icon, .share-btn, .nav-toggle, .edu-bubble.glass, .t-chip, .dt-btn { background-position-x:  !important; background-position-y:  !important; background-size:  !important; background-repeat:  !important; background-attachment:  !important; background-origin:  !important; background-clip:  !important; background-color:  !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) !important; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 0px 2px 6px !important; background-image: none !important; }

@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))){body.toc-home nav, body.toc-sub nav { background: rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.92) !important; }.hero-ctas .hero-cta, .wm-cta .btn, .nav-help a, .sticky-help, a.help-btn { background: var(--lg-solid,#1d3f73) !important; }}
